symptom: Internal GitHub PR/ref synchronization, commit SHA, queued Required-run and not-yet-LIVE_BEWEZEN details were repeatedly surfaced in chat.
The user had to read implementation plumbing that Powerhouse should autonomously resolve.
root_cause: The prior terminal-handoff rule prohibited pending state as a final answer but still allowed intermediate status narration while execution continued.
User-facing reporting and machine-readable execution observability were not explicitly separated.
prevention: Keep internal delivery state in canonical logs, evidence, ledgers and provider/GitHub state rather than routine chat output.
Default user-facing reporting to terminal outcomes only.
Expose BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY only when a genuinely external human permission, credential or irreversible decision is required, and ask only for the minimum action.
Reveal technical delivery diagnostics only when the user explicitly requests them.
Interruption is not a handoff; resume autonomously from canonical state.
failed_approaches: Reporting PR head/ref mismatches and queued checks as progress updates.
Using 'nog niet LIVE_BEWEZEN' as a user-facing intermediate state.
